decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith NK017217_0100, NK017217_0101, NK017217_0102, NK017217_0103, NK017217_0104, NK017217_0105 (received 11/10/2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The proposed fencing shall be powder coated when it is installed.
description: Alterations to the existing service yard area including replacement of existing block paving with concrete, alterations to the existing car parking layout and the installation of a new 3m high palisade fence
